## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 437 captures during November 2025. Activity was completed as part of the routine service, with staff maintaining the planned process for image capture and referral. Staff reported no new equipment faults during the month.

## Image quality

Of the 437 captures, 84 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 19.2. The ungradable images could not be used for grading, and the result indicates that image quality remains an area for continued operational attention. Staff should continue to follow the established capture process and review image quality during clinic activity.

## Grading

Grading identified 95 referable results from the captures completed during November 2025. The median lag between capture and grading was 2 days. This provides a timely grading turnaround for the month and supports appropriate follow-up of referable results. The site should continue to monitor both the number of ungradable captures and grading turnaround as part of routine service oversight.
